priority_review.rationale: This is not a routine leader date: COTTON CLUB and Stampley's own on-page message frame the engagement around improvisation, creativity, cross-cultural dialogue and previously unperformed new compositions. The rotating Tokyo drummers materially change the music, with September 20 especially notable because Stampley and Senri Kawaguchi are extending a musical connection formed during a Berlin recording session earlier in 2026 into a live Tokyo setting.

events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Jahari Stampley: Soul Family featuring Taishi Kubota / Senri Kawaguchi on September 19-20, 2026, with 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets on both days. Jahari Stampley and D-Erania Stampley perform both nights; Taishi Kubota is the drummer on September 19 and Senri Kawaguchi on September 20. In a message published on the exact event page, Stampley says he met Kawaguchi during a Berlin studio recording session earlier in 2026, felt a strong musical connection, and wanted to hear her interpretation of his new compositions in Tokyo. He describes the project around What A Time as centered on improvisation, creativity and cross-cultural musical dialogue, and states that the shows will include album material plus new compositions not previously performed anywhere.

en.why_it_matters: The reason this reaches S is not Stampley's competition pedigree by itself. The engagement is explicitly designed as a live experiment in improvisation and cross-cultural musical dialogue: the same core project meets two different Japanese drummers on consecutive nights, and Stampley says the shows will include music that has never been performed anywhere before. September 20 is especially compelling because Senri Kawaguchi is carrying a musical connection formed with Stampley during a Berlin studio session earlier this year into a Tokyo club setting. That makes the interaction, not the résumé, the event.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect one of the four sets and cross Tokyo specifically for it; if choosing only one night, September 20 with Senri Kawaguchi is the stronger Listening Notes bet because the documented Berlin-to-Tokyo connection and unheard new compositions make the encounter unusually specific. It remains below S+ because this is a two-night engagement by an active young project rather than a farewell, singular premiere or historical one-off.

es.why_it_matters: Lo que lleva esta fecha a S no es por sí solo el pedigree de concursos de Stampley. La residencia está planteada explícitamente como un experimento en vivo de improvisación y diálogo musical entre culturas: el mismo proyecto central se encuentra con dos bateristas japoneses distintos en noches consecutivas, y Stampley dice que tocarán música que nunca antes se ha presentado en ningún lugar. El 20 de septiembre es especialmente atractivo porque Senri Kawaguchi lleva a un club de Tokio una conexión musical que nació con Stampley durante una sesión de estudio en Berlín a principios de este año. El acontecimiento es la interacción, no el currículum.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Vale proteger uno de los cuatro sets y cruzar Tokio específicamente por él; si hubiera que escoger una sola noche, el 20 de septiembre con Senri Kawaguchi es la apuesta más fuerte para Listening Notes porque la conexión Berlín→Tokio ya documentada y las composiciones nuevas todavía inéditas vuelven el encuentro particularmente específico. Se queda debajo de S+ porque es una residencia de dos noches de un proyecto joven y activo, no una despedida, un estreno singular o un acontecimiento histórico irrepetible.
